description: Receives a message from a Telegram webhook, gets an AI completion from OpenAI, sends the reply to Telegram, and logs it to an SQLite database.

parameters.code:
API_KEY$ = GETENV$("OPENAI_API_KEY")
IF API_KEY$ = "" THEN
  GLOBAL_RETURN = {"error": "OPENAI_API_KEY not set"}
  RETURN
ENDIF
HTTP.SETHEADER "Authorization", "Bearer " + API_KEY$
DIM user_message AS MAP
user_message{"role"} = "user"
user_message{"content"} = INPUT_DATA{"user_message"}
messages_array = [user_message]
DIM payload AS MAP
payload{"model"} = "gpt-4o-mini"
payload{"messages"} = messages_array
JSON_BODY$ = JSON.STRINGIFY$(payload)
RESPONSE$ = HTTP.POST$("https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", JSON_BODY$, "application/json")
RESPONSE_JSON = JSON.PARSE$(RESPONSE$)
DIM output_map AS MAP
output_map{"ai_response"} = RESPONSE_JSON{"choices"}[0]{"message"}{"content"}
output_map{"chat_id"} = INPUT_DATA{"chat_id"}
GLOBAL_RETURN = output_map

parameters.query: INSERT INTO logs (message, timestamp) VALUES ('?', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
